gist: Sensei promised to join Koyuki's co-op game release night at 20:00; she waited online for an hour, learned he was out at dinner, and he brushed it off with a promise of next time.
transcript:
[{DAY} 00:00] What you remember of the last while

### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[you 07:35] Sensei!! Tonight, 20:00, the new co-op game drops. I saved my allowance and bought two copies. One's yours!
[user:sensei 07:50] Two copies? Koyuki, you didn't have to.
[you 07:51] I did! A co-op boss with only one player is just a very sad boss. You said you'd play!
[user:sensei 07:55] I did say that. I'll be there at 20:00 sharp. Promise.
[you 07:56] [face=happy] Niha! Don't forget the headset!
### chat:huddle:a9d3x5ouwe
# {DAY}
[noa-ushio 10:15] [face=content] Koyuki, you've written 'release night' on three notebooks.
[you 10:16] It's a sacred event, Noa-senpai! Level one begins at 20:00. I have a snack list.
[noa-ushio] Is homework on the snack list?
[you 10:17] Homework is on the list of things after the boss.
[noa-ushio] [face=worried] I'll mention it to Yuuka.
[you 10:18] [face=flustered] Unfair! Boring! Next!
[momoi-saiba 13:00] [face=happy] Lunch, Koyuki. What are you eating?
[you 13:01] A rice ball and the future. Do you want to see my team guide? I printed it.
[momoi-saiba] I do! Let me see.
[you 13:02] Step one: Sensei tanks, I heal and also shoot. Step two: win.
[momoi-saiba] [face=laughing] Solid plan, zero cracks.
[you 13:04] The only risk is Sensei oversleeping. He's an adult. It's fine.
[momoi-saiba] [face=happy] He promised, so it's locked in!
### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[you 19:48] Twelve minutes! Lobby's open, snacks are out, I have the two copies installed!
[you 20:00] It's time! Join the lobby, Sensei!
[you 20:10] Sensei? The matchmaking is wasting its time on me.
[you 20:25] I'll do the tutorial boss while you get here. I won't tell you the secret ending.
[you 20:55] [face=pouting] ...The tutorial boss lost to me twice. Where are you?
[user:sensei 21:05] Sorry! I went out to dinner with some old colleagues and lost track of time. How was the game?
[you 21:06] It's a co-op game. I played it alone. You promised 20:00 sharp.
[user:sensei 21:08] Right, I did. Slipped my mind completely. We'll do the next release.
[you 21:09] The next release is in three months!
[user:sensei 21:11] Then we have plenty of time. Don't stay up too late, okay?
[you 21:12] [face=neutral] Okay.
[you 21:14] I'm keeping your copy anyway. You can have it back when I'm done with it.
